Maryland.focus: Workforce, sustainable access and innovative care, eating for health
Maryland.description: Maryland plans to improve the health of the one-third of residents who live in rural areas through three goals, funded by quick-start Immediate Impact Funds and competitive Transformation Funds.
initiatives: Transform the Rural Health Workforce
Apprenticeships and upskilling for community health workers and others, plus a pipeline of future rural health professionals.
Sustainable Access and Innovative Care
More primary, specialty and school-based care, AI-supported risk alerts, telehealth, remote monitoring and mobile health.
Eat for Health
Improving consistent access to healthy food.

Massachusetts.focus: Access, well-being and scalable systems for 700,000 rural residents
Massachusetts.description: Massachusetts targets its 700,000 rural residents, 10% of the state's population across 160 rural jurisdictions, where rural hospitals fell from 11 in 2014 to 6 in 2025.
initiatives: Access to care
Ensuring rural residents can readily reach primary, specialty, maternal and pediatric care.
Health and well-being
Opportunities to improve the health and well-being of rural residents.
Scaling systems and policies
Systems, policies and investments that meet the needs of rural communities.

Michigan.focus: Regional partnerships, workforce, technology and care close to home
Michigan.description: Michigan plans to build regional partnerships across health, human services and community sectors, grow the rural workforce, and advance technology so residents can get care close to home.
initiatives: Regional partnerships
Partnerships among rural hospitals, clinics and community organizations to coordinate care and expand access points.
Workforce
Recruiting and retaining rural health professionals, behavioral health providers and community health workers.
Technology and interoperability
A rural technology catalyst fund for data exchange, telehealth, remote monitoring and care coordination tools.
Digital referral networks
Connecting residents to local care, prevention and wellness resources.

Minnesota.focus: Cardiometabolic health, workforce, access, partnerships and provider finances
Minnesota.description: Minnesota's plan, led by the Department of Health, uses five goals to improve cardiometabolic outcomes, grow the rural workforce and stabilize rural providers.
initiatives: Cardiometabolic disease
Better outcomes for rural residents with or at risk of cardiovascular disease, diabetes and chronic kidney disease.
Workforce pathways
Education pathways and training opportunities in rural communities.
New access points
Community screenings and chronic disease management through technology, mobile care and frontline workers.
Provider financial health
Technology, data infrastructure and collaborative mechanisms for rural providers.

Mississippi.focus: Six integrated initiatives from regional systems to infrastructure
Mississippi.description: Mississippi plans six integrated initiatives to strengthen access, workforce and service delivery, beginning with a statewide rural health assessment to target investments.
initiatives: Coordinated Regional Integrated Systems
Integrating EMS, hospitals, public health and social services into regional healthcare districts.
Workforce Expansion Initiative
Retention awards, residency expansion, preceptor development and 'Earn While You Learn' programs.
HTAM and TAPS
Health IT modernization, telehealth infrastructure, cybersecurity and consumer-facing tools.
BRIDGE
Capital investments and psychiatric emergency services.
